points.description: States that backpropagation is used to reduce/minimise the error (loss) of a multi-layer perceptron / neural network with multiple layers, by working through the network layer by layer (recursively/iteratively).

States that the error is propagated backwards from the last (output) layer to the first layer, and that the weights are updated as a result. Equivalent wording (e.g. gradient/delta-based weight updates going backwards) earns the mark.
